scope: Compare two native text operands with an explicitly selected stock pg_catalog.C collation and an exact builtin operator. Compose in Boolean result, SELECT filter, ordinary ON, UPDATE filter, DELETE filter and existing Boolean owners.

Predicate/Text/TextComparison.role: A nullable Boolean comparison of two ordered native text values.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.structure: An exact operator, two text literal, native text slot or typed NULL operands, and the effective canonical builtin collation.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.conditions: Both field operands must refer to visible native text slots. In analyzed SQL at least one operand explicitly resolves to pg_catalog.C. Each explicit collation must resolve to the same builtin. The resolved comparison operator is the pg_catalog text/text operator.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.meaning: A NULL operand yields NULL. Otherwise compare the original UTF-8 byte sequences with the selected operation. A Boolean owner uses its existing truth and placement rules.
Predicate/Text/TextComparison.sql: Render a parenthesized qualified stock operator on the two typed operands. Apply the chosen explicit collation to the left operand using the native operand renderer, independent of which original operand carried the same explicit collation.

Predicate/Text/TextOperator.role: The builtin comparison operation for PostgreSQL text/text arguments.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.structure: Six closed alternatives for equality, inequality and ordered comparisons, each with its builtin operator name.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.conditions: The stock native profile exposes pg_catalog text/text operators with Boolean results and strict null behavior. The SQL alias != resolves to <>.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.meaning: Interpret the sign of the collation's three-way comparison according to the chosen operation.
Predicate/Text/TextOperator.sql: Emit the selected fixed name through OPERATOR(pg_catalog.symbol).
